# App spec — Sales Pulse

> Generated by brand-ui new-app (example fixture). This spec is the source of
> truth for the scaffold; the fenced `json` block below is the machine-readable
> contract `brand-ui scaffold` consumes (schema: `app-spec.schema.json`).

## Intent

- **Purpose:** Give a sales lead an at-a-glance read on pipeline health.
- **Audience:** Internal sales leadership.
- **Scale:** internal tool.

## Archetype

- **dashboard** → template `template-dashboard`, playbook `playbooks/dashboard.md`

## Surfaces & navigation

| Surface  | Nav label | Archetype | Notes                       |
| -------- | --------- | --------- | --------------------------- |
| overview | Overview  | dashboard | KPI row + trend + deal list |
| deals    | Deals     | data-app  | Full deal table             |

Nav: sidebar (one item per surface).

## Entities

### Deal

| Field  | Type                        | Renders as | Filterable |
| ------ | --------------------------- | ---------- | ---------- |
| name   | text                        | text cell  | search     |
| value  | number                      | number     | —          |
| stage  | status: open \| won \| lost | Badge      | facet      |
| closed | date                        | date       | —          |

## Brand & feel

- **Theme:** qlik-dark
- **Density / decoration:** default

## Per-surface detail

### overview

- KPIs: Pipeline value, Win rate, Avg deal size, Deals closed (4 tiles).
- Charts: bar (value by stage) + line (value over time).
- Deal list below (name · value · stage · closed).

## Machine spec

The contract `brand-ui scaffold` reads (kept in sync with the prose above):

```json
{
  "archetype": "dashboard",
  "theme": "qlik-dark",
  "title": "Sales Pulse",
  "intent": {
    "purpose": "Give a sales lead an at-a-glance read on pipeline health.",
    "audience": "Internal sales leadership.",
    "scale": "internal"
  },
  "density": "default",
  "surfaces": [
    { "id": "overview", "navLabel": "Overview", "archetype": "dashboard" },
    { "id": "deals", "navLabel": "Deals", "archetype": "data-app" }
  ],
  "entities": [
    {
      "name": "Deal",
      "fields": [
        { "name": "name", "type": "text", "rendersAs": "text cell", "filterable": "search" },
        { "name": "value", "type": "number", "rendersAs": "number" },
        { "name": "stage", "type": "status", "rendersAs": "Badge", "filterable": "facet" },
        { "name": "closed", "type": "date", "rendersAs": "date" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
